items.titleEn: Key takeaways: Cease dominates Red Sox with one-hit shutout
bodyEn: BOSTON -- The Blue Jays still have some flashes in them, especially when Dylan Cease pitches like that.
Saturday’s 6-0 win over the Red Sox was clean and simple, which we haven’t seen enough of from this 2026 team. The win moves the Blue Jays to 48-57.
This is what mattered most:
1. Dylan Cease one-hits the Red Sox

For a moment, it felt like Cease was going to take another run at Dave Stieb, like he did just before the All-Star break in San Francisco. Stieb still lives on as the only no-hitter in franchise history, but Cease was spectacular in Saturday’s win. This was the Blue Jays’ first complete game of the season as Cease allowed just one hit, a double to Andruw Monasterio in the sixth.
It’s the Blue Jays’ first complete game one-hitter since Shaun Marcum on August 16, 2010. Just eight days prior to that, Brandon Morrow did the same in his incredible 17-strikeout game.

Early on, his velocity was downright worrying. His fastball sat below 94 mph in the first inning, alarming from a pitcher who sits 97-98 mph and can touch 100 mph. It slowly crept up as the game went on, though, similar to what we’ve seen over the years from Kevin Gausman. To Cease’s credit, he also controlled this game extremely well, getting the Red Sox hitters to swing through some of his softer stuff while he settled in.
This still looks like Cease versus Cam Schlittler of the Yankees for the AL Cy Young Award. Cease now owns a 2.46 ERA with 167 strikeouts over 113 1/3 innings.
2) Stock up: George Springer

Springer’s three-run home run in the third inning snuck over the Green Monster in left and continued a stretch where he’s looked more like his 2025 self recently. Sure, the Blue Jays wish it had been this way all along, but better now than never.

Springer is one of the most interesting trade options on this roster, and will appeal to different clubs in very different ways. While some contenders simply would not have a spot for Springer, who is limited to the DH spot with the odd day in the corner outfield, other contenders in need of a veteran DH or bench bat could easily see the upside here. Springer is a former World Series MVP with the Astros, and last October, delivered one of the biggest moments in Blue Jays history with his Game 7 ALCS home run against the Mariners.

There’s a certain level of “feel” to Springer’s value, beyond the 2026 numbers. Consider the Red Sox to be one of the contenders who could make sense for Springer, but if he looks good in the coming days, that list may grow.

Money will be a factor, too. Springer is earning just over $24 million this year, the final year of his six-year, $150 million deal. This could be a scenario where the Blue Jays can eat some of that salary in return for a greater prospect return.
3) The right direction for Vladdy
Vladimir Guerrero Jr. reached base four times, including a line-drive single to left field to bring home the Blue Jays’ first run of the game.
Before the game, Guerrero met with the media to address the Blue Jays’ disappointing season, asking the fans for patience and preaching that anything can happen over their final 57 games.

“Before even thinking about [media] or the Trade Deadline, myself and the entire team have to play better,” Guerrero said through interpreter Hector Lebron. “Every time I leave the field, going back to the hotel, that’s all I’m thinking of, seeing how we can get better.”

Guerrero’s season won’t truly turn around until some of these start going over the wall, as he’s stuck at just six home runs this season. There’s no arguing with a day like this, though, and as manager John Schneider said before the game, it’s important for Guerrero to “show the way” to his teammates as they go through a down year.
items.titleZh: 关键要点：Cease一安打完封红袜
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟6-0完胜，Cease一安打完封，Springer轰出三分炮，Guerrero四度上垒。
bodyZh: 波士顿——蓝鸟仍有闪光时刻，尤其是Dylan Cease那样的投球时。
周六6-0战胜红袜的比赛干净利落，这支2026赛季的球队此前很少有这样的表现。这场胜利使蓝鸟战绩来到48胜57负。
以下是最重要的几点：
1. Dylan Cease一安打完封红袜
那一刻，感觉Cease要再次挑战Dave Stieb的纪录，就像全明星周末前在旧金山那样。Stieb仍是队史唯一无安打比赛的创造者，但Cease在周六的胜利中表现惊艳。这是蓝鸟本赛季首场完投，Cease只被击出一支安打——第六局Andruw Monasterio的二垒安打。
这是蓝鸟自2010年8月16日Shaun Marcum以来首次完投一安比赛。八天前，Brandon Morrow在令人难以置信的17次三振比赛中也做到了这一点。
比赛初期，他的球速令人担忧。首节快速球平均低于94英里/小时，对于一个通常投97-98英里/小时、能触及100英里/小时的投手来说令人震惊。不过，随着比赛进行，球速逐渐回升，类似于多年来Kevin Gausman的惯常表现。值得称赞的是，Cease还很好地控制了比赛，在逐渐进入状态的过程中，让红袜打者挥空了一些较软的球路。
这仍然是Cease与洋基的Cam Schlittler争夺美联赛扬奖的局面。Cease目前自责分率2.46，在113又1/3局中送出167次三振。
2) 升值：George Springer
Springer在第三局的三分本垒打越过左外野绿色怪物，延续了他近期更像是2025年状态的表现。当然，蓝鸟希望他整个赛季都如此，但迟到总比没有好。
Springer是这支阵容中最有趣的交易选项之一，会以非常不同的方式吸引不同球队。虽然一些竞争者可能没有Springer的位置——他仅限于指定打击和偶尔的角落外野——但其他需要老将指定打击或替补打者的竞争者很容易看到他的潜力。Springer是前太空人世界大赛MVP，去年十月，他在对水手的ALCS第七战中轰出蓝鸟队史最重大的本垒打之一。
Springer的价值有一定的“感觉”成分，超出了2026年的数据。红袜是一个潜在的合适竞争者，但如果他在接下来几天表现出色，这个名单可能会扩大。
金钱也是一个因素。Springer今年薪资略高于2400万美元，这是他六年1.5亿美元合同的最后一年。可能的情况是，蓝鸟可以承担部分薪水以换取更好的新秀回报。
3) Vladdy走在正确的方向上
Vladimir Guerrero Jr.四次上垒，包括一支左外野平飞一垒安打，为蓝鸟带回本场第一分。
赛前，Guerrero接受媒体采访，谈到了蓝鸟令人失望的赛季，请求球迷保持耐心，并强调在最后57场比赛中一切皆有可能。
“在考虑（媒体）或交易截止日之前，我和整个球队都必须打得更好，”Guerrero通过翻译Hector Lebron表示。“每次我离开球场回到酒店，我都在想如何变得更好。”
Guerrero的赛季真正扭转还需要一些本垒打，他本赛季只有六支。但像这样的一天无可争议，正如主帅John Schneider赛前所说，在球队经历低迷之年时，Guerrero为队友“指明方向”很重要。
items.author: Keegan Matheson

items.titleEn: In a much different spot than last season, Vlad Jr. talks about his struggles in '26
bodyEn: BOSTON -- Just over a year ago, Vladimir Guerrero Jr. stood in this same rugged hallway at Fenway Park. It was the beginning of the greatest year of his baseball life.

He’d just signed a $500 million contract that morning. He didn’t know it yet, but a World Series run was laid out in front of him, and in six months, he’d be the most popular man in the country. Saturday afternoon, he walked down that same hallway, between all of the brick and concrete, and last year suddenly felt so long ago.

We’re talking about endings now, not beginnings. The 47-57 Blue Jays are careening towards the Trade Deadline as sellers. Just as Guerrero’s brilliance defined the 2025 Blue Jays, his struggles define this year’s team.

Entering Saturday, Guerrero has just six home runs this season, tied for 223rd in baseball. Of the 147 qualified hitters, his .354 slugging percentage ranks Guerrero 132nd. Rays speedster Chandler Simpson, who’s never homered in the big leagues, sits one spot above him. Everywhere you look, this gets more stunning.

“There’s still 58 games left. I know I’m better than that and I know I can get better,” Guerrero said through interpreter Hector Lebron. “It’s frustrating. There’s 58 games left and you know how baseball is. Anything can happen. Myself and the rest of the guys, we’ve just got to continue to play hard.”

Guerrero asked fans to be patient, which is a tricky proposal. Blue Jays fans came into this season with World Series expectations, because of course they did. This season hasn’t just been a disappointment in the standings, it’s seen the Blue Jays lose the identity that made them a countrywide sensation in 2025. They’re dead last in MLB in runs scored. Unless you’re playing airtight defense with a few Cy Young candidates in the rotation, that’s never going to work.

The face of the franchise isn’t oblivious to this, of course. That $500 million contract signs you up for expectations and criticisms that others simply don’t face. We can debate where the line is on what’s “fair," but part of Guerrero’s job description is now to take on more media responsibilities, more pressure and more responsibility than everyone else in that clubhouse.

“He’s dealt with it forever, good or bad,” manager John Schneider said. “When he’s good, that’s what he’s supposed to do. When he’s not, it’s, ‘What the hell are you doing?’ He’s handling it well. It’s important for him to really show the way here when times are tough. He’s somebody who the guys look up to and follow. It’s a little extra for him. Him talking to you guys and saying he’s not playing as good as he can be and we’re not playing as good as we can be is accountability.”

There’s also a difference between public messaging and what happens when the clubhouse doors close. All of those times Schneider sits at the podium, holding steady for his team and preaching his belief in the next day? That’s just the version we see. Minutes later, he could be lighting up the clubhouse or sitting a player down in his office.

Schneider knows Guerrero as well as anyone, at least anyone without the last name “Guerrero." Beyond the 2025 World Series, he was right there for Guerrero’s best days as the No. 1 prospect in the game, standing on the top step of the dugout and watching on in awe. Schneider knows the incredible things Guerrero is capable of, but we haven’t seen them in too long.

“He’s trying to capture the same thing. When it’s right, he’s one of the best,” Schneider said. “He’s trying to get there and not reinvent himself at this point. It’s just being on time, hitting the ball hard and whatever happens is going to happen. It always comes down to what you’re swinging at. If he’s swinging in the zone, he’s pretty good.”

Guerrero isn’t the only reason the Blue Jays are in this spot, only one of dozens. If you look at that long list, though, Guerrero’s name stands out. It’s the most surprising story of the season, a season which is just over a week away from what could be a dark day at the Trade Deadline.
“I let the front office do their job,” Guerrero said. “I’m going to focus and concentrate on doing my job.”
That’s how he’s always wanted it. Guerrero’s job description changed in these Fenway hallways a year ago, though, and now, he’s seen both sides of what that brings.
items.titleZh: 与上赛季截然不同，小弗拉迪谈2026赛季挣扎
items.summaryZh: 小弗拉基米尔·格雷罗谈本赛季挣扎，蓝鸟队陷入困境。
bodyZh: 波士顿——就在一年多前，小弗拉基米尔·格雷罗站在芬威球场这条崎岖的走廊上。那是他棒球生涯最伟大一年的开始。
那天早上他刚签下一份5亿美元的合同。他还不知道，但一次世界大赛征程已摆在他面前，六个月后，他将成为这个国家最受欢迎的人。周六下午，他再次走过那条走廊，穿梭在砖石之间，去年突然感觉如此遥远。
现在我们谈论的是结局，而非开始。47胜57负的蓝鸟正作为卖家冲向交易截止日。正如格雷罗的辉煌定义了2025年的蓝鸟，他的挣扎定义了今年的球队。
截至周六，格雷罗本赛季仅打出6支本垒打，并列大联盟第223位。在147名符合资格的打者中，他的长打率.354排名第132位。光芒队快腿钱德勒·辛普森，这位从未在大联盟击出本垒打的球员，排名比他高一位。无论从哪个角度看，这都令人震惊。
“还有58场比赛。我知道我比这更好，我也知道我可以变得更好，”格雷罗通过翻译Hector Lebron表示，“这很令人沮丧。还有58场比赛，你知道棒球是什么样的。任何事情都可能发生。我和其他队友，我们只需要继续努力打球。”
格雷罗请求球迷保持耐心，这是一个棘手的提议。蓝鸟球迷带着世界大赛的期望进入本赛季，他们当然会这样。本赛季不仅在战绩上令人失望，蓝鸟还失去了让他们在2025年成为全国热点的身份。他们的得分在大联盟垫底。除非你拥有滴水不漏的防守和轮值中几位赛扬奖候选人，否则这永远行不通。
当然，球队的门面并非对此视而不见。那份5亿美元的合同带来了他人无需面对的期望和批评。我们可以争论“公平”的界限在哪里，但格雷罗的工作描述的一部分就是现在要承担比更衣室里其他人更多的媒体责任、更多的压力和更多的责任。
“他一直在处理这件事，无论好坏，”主教练John Schneider说，“当他表现好时，那是他该做的。当他表现不好时，就是‘你到底在搞什么？’他处理得很好。在困难时期，他真正起到带头作用很重要。他是队友们仰望和追随的人。这对他来说是额外的。他对你们媒体说他自己打得不够好，我们全队打得不够好，这是一种担当。”
公开信息与更衣室门关闭后发生的事情之间也存在差异。所有那些Schneider坐在讲台上，为球队保持镇定并宣扬他对明天的信念的时刻？那只是我们看到的版本。几分钟后，他可能会在更衣室里发火，或者叫球员到办公室谈话。
Schneider比任何人都了解格雷罗，至少比任何不姓“格雷罗”的人都了解。除了2025年世界大赛，他还见证了格雷罗作为头号新秀的最佳时光，站在休息区最高台阶上敬畏地观看。Schneider知道格雷罗能够做到多么不可思议的事情，但我们太久没有看到了。
“他在努力重现同样的东西。当一切都对了，他是最好的之一，”Schneider说，“他正在努力达到那个状态，而不是现在重新改造自己。只是要准时到位，用力击球，然后顺其自然。一切都归结于你在挥击什么球。如果他在好球带内挥棒，他就很出色。”
蓝鸟陷入这种境地，格雷罗不是唯一原因，只是众多原因之一。然而，如果你看看那长长的名单，格雷罗的名字格外突出。这是本赛季最令人惊讶的故事，而距离可能成为交易截止日黑暗日的时间只剩一周多。
“我让管理层做他们的工作，”格雷罗说，“我会专注并集中精力做好我的工作。”
他一直希望如此。然而，一年前在芬威的走廊里，格雷罗的工作描述发生了变化，而现在，他看到了这带来的两面。

items.titleEn: Yesavage battles in 9-K start as Wild Card gap widens ahead of Deadline
bodyEn: BOSTON -- Even when the Blue Jays find a way to make a game of it, the American League Wild Card race just keeps drifting away from them.
Friday night’s 6-4 loss to the Red Sox at Fenway Park dropped the Blue Jays (47-57) to 6 1/2 games back of the final Wild Card spot with the Aug. 3 Trade Deadline looming.
This is what mattered most:
1. Okamoto can’t do it all himself

Kazuma Okamoto breathed some life back into this game with a three-run shot in the seventh, which broke Shohei Ohtani’s 2018 record for home runs by a Japanese-born rookie with 23. Without any help, though, that lives on as a footnote in another loss.

This could have been the go-ahead blast, but the Blue Jays let Patrick Sandoval off the hook in the first inning and handed the Red Sox a zero on the scoreboard. Toronto loaded the bases, even watching Sandoval throw 10 straight balls at one point, but Davis Schneider looked at strike three to end the threat.

“The first inning, this team’s about as hot as you can get, right?” manager John Schneider said. “And they’re coming off an off-day, so you want to take advantage of anything you can early. We had traffic, but we left a lot of guys on and had some pitches to hit that we didn’t capitalize on. I love the way they battled back, a big at-bat from Okamoto and then getting one in the eighth, but early on, we probably could have done a bit more.”

The Blue Jays’ numbers with the bases loaded this season aren’t pretty. They’ve actually run into the odd burst of power with three grand slams over their 57 at-bats, but oddly enough, their contact ability hasn’t shown up. The Blue Jays rank second-last in baseball with a .193 average in these situations, better than only the Marlins (.173).

Let’s not pretend that 57 at-bats are enough of a sample size to draw major conclusions from, but this is yet another layer to why the offense has struggled. Big hits in big moments have been lacking, and were again on Friday.
2. We saw every version of Yesavage
At some points, Trey Yesavage looked like the rookie who lit MLB on fire last season. Even after the long, shaky first frame, he came right back and struck out the side in the second.

Yesavage’s pitch count ran up quickly, though, a product of a whopping nine strikeouts over just four innings -- which the Blue Jays will happily take -- but also the long at-bats that got him there. Even in that second inning with three strikeouts, Yesavage had a couple of eight-pitch battles. Turning some of those into a four-pitch strikeout, or even a weak ground ball on the second pitch he throws, is the key to unlocking the rest of his potential.
“I was getting ahead early. I think every batter I faced, I got to a two-strike count,” Yesavage said. “It’s just a matter of putting them away, which really drove up the pitch count.”

If everything already points to 2027 and beyond at this point, which it very well might, Yesavage’s growth is one of the most important factors in this organization. He owns a 3.92 ERA over 85 innings, on pace to land somewhere in the range of 150 this season. That would be a great baseline heading into ‘27, but the efficiency from start to start remains crucial.
“We just need to come together, win ballgames and play for each other,” Yesavage said.
3. Could the Red Sox be a trade partner?

For now, the Blue Jays are chasing the Red Sox and Guardians, who are in a tight race holding the second and third Wild Card spots. Between the Blue Jays and those teams are the Mariners, Twins, Astros, Orioles and Tigers, so there’s nothing simple about this. Toronto’s postseason odds are shrinking by the day.

These two teams could soon line up as trade partners, which has happened before. When the Blue Jays were out of the race in 2024, they traded Danny Jansen to Boston for prospects Cutter Coffey (Toronto’s No. 22 prospect per MLB Pipeline), Eddinson Paulino and Gilberto Bautista. In 2018, the Blue Jays traded Steve Pearce to the Red Sox, who went on to be the World Series MVP.
If George Springer is dealt -- which looks likely at this point -- it’s easy to see a potential fit with the Red Sox as a veteran DH type and part-time outfielder.
items.titleZh: 耶萨维奇9K再战，外卡差距在交易截止日前扩大
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟6-4负红袜，外卡落后6.5场；冈本和真破纪录本垒打难救主。
bodyZh: 波士顿——即使蓝鸟能让比赛有悬念，美国联盟外卡争夺却离他们越来越远。
周五晚上在芬威公园以6-4输给红袜后，蓝鸟（47胜57负）在交易截止日（8月3日）前夕，距离最后一个外卡席位落后6.5场。
以下是本场比赛最关键的几点：
1. 冈本和真无法独自扛起球队
冈本和真在第七局轰出三分本垒打，以23支本垒打打破了大谷翔平2018年创下的日本出生新秀本垒打纪录，为比赛注入了一些活力。然而，没有其他帮助，这只能成为又一场失利的注脚。
这本可能是反超的一击，但蓝鸟在首局让Patrick Sandoval轻松脱身，让红袜在记分板上挂零。多伦多一度满垒，甚至看到Sandoval连续投出10个坏球，但Davis Schneider目送第三球被三振，化解了威胁。
“第一局，这支球队状态火热，对吧？”主教练John Schneider说。“而且他们刚休息了一天，所以你想尽早利用任何机会。我们有人上垒，但留下很多跑者，有些好球没把握住。我喜欢他们反击的方式，冈本的关键打席和第八局得分，但早期我们本可以做得更多。”
蓝鸟本赛季在满垒时的数据并不好看。实际上他们有过三次满贯本垒打，在57个打数中偶尔爆发火力，但奇怪的是，他们的击球能力并没有显现。蓝鸟在满垒时的打击率为.193，排名联盟倒数第二，仅好于马林鱼（.173）。
我们别假装57个打数是足够得出重大结论的样本量，但这只是进攻挣扎的又一个层面。关键时刻的安打一直缺乏，周五也不例外。
2. 我们看到了耶萨维奇的各种版本
在某些时刻，Trey Yesavage看起来像上赛季点燃大联盟的新秀。即使在漫长的、不稳定的第一局之后，他立刻回稳，在第二局三振了对手侧。
然而，Yesavage的用球数迅速上升，这是他在仅仅四局内送出九次三振的代价——蓝鸟对此会欣然接受——但也因为那些漫长的打席。即使在第二局的三次三振中，Yesavage也有几次八球对决。如果能将其中一些变成四球三振，或者第二个投球就制造弱滚地球，是释放他其余潜力的关键。
“我早早取得球数领先。我想我面对每个打者都取得了两好球，”Yesavage说。“只是解决他们的问题，这确实推高了用球数。”
如果在这一点上一切都指向2027年及以后，很可能确实如此，那么Yesavage的成长是这支球队最重要的因素之一。他在85局中自责分率为3.92，本赛季有望投到150局左右。这将是进入27年的良好基准，但从一场先发到下一场的效率仍然至关重要。
“我们只需要团结起来，赢得比赛，为彼此而战，”Yesavage说。
3. 红袜可能成为交易伙伴？
目前，蓝鸟正在追赶红袜和守护者，这两队正激烈争夺第二和第三外卡席位。在蓝鸟和这些球队之间还有水手、双城、太空人、金莺和老虎，所以没有任何简单办法。多伦多的季后赛概率日益缩小。
这两支球队很快可能成为交易伙伴，这以前发生过。2024年蓝鸟退出竞争时，他们将Danny Jansen交易到波士顿，换来潜力新秀Cutter Coffey（MLB Pipeline蓝鸟第22号新秀）、Eddinson Paulino和Gilberto Bautista。2018年，蓝鸟将Steve Pearce交易到红袜，后者随后成为世界大赛MVP。
如果George Springer被交易——现在看来很有可能——很容易看到他与红袜的潜在契合，作为一名资深指定打击型和兼职外野手。

items.titleEn: Ohtani held this record until last night -- but not anymore, thanks to Okamoto
bodyEn: BOSTON -- With one big swing on Friday night at Fenway Park, Kazuma Okamoto broke Shohei Ohtani’s rookie record for the most home runs by a Japanese-born player, with 23.

The Statcast-projected 408-foot shot to straightaway center finally got the Blue Jays on the board in the seventh inning in an eventual 6-4 loss to the Red Sox. In a quiet season for the lowest-scoring offense in Major League Baseball, Okamoto has been one of the lone bright spots.
“That’s pretty cool that he sets the Japanese rookie record for homers in a season. That’s a great accomplishment for him, and I told him that,” manager John Schneider said. “He’s so talented.”

Any day your name lands in the same sentence as Ohtani’s is a good one, and even though Okamoto has downplayed any milestone, his respect for his fellow Japanese star is clear. The two have also played together in the World Baseball Classic, representing their country.

“It’s just a number,” Okamoto said through interpreter Yusuke Oshima when he tied the record just prior to the All-Star break. “As you all know, Shohei is an awesome player. He’s a unicorn. To be able to match that record is obviously awesome. I want to do my best so that I can get closer to his level.”

That hadn’t changed by Friday night, either. As we all get to know Okamoto -- from fans to media and teammates -- it’s immediately clear that he’s a team-first player. He’ll deflect the conversation back to his teammates and the team’s success any time he can. Anything to take the attention off himself and his own accomplishments, no matter how impressive they are.
“There’s nothing in particular [I care about] on the personal side,” Okamoto said. “Just getting the ‘W.’ That’s the only category I’m looking at.”

Okamoto doesn’t hit cheap ones, either. There are no wall-scrapers and no batted-ball luck in this new Japanese rookie record, and while Okamoto has certainly struggled with strikeouts at times, his power has been undeniable. The Blue Jays’ offense has been searching for answers anywhere and everywhere, but power has been one of this group’s biggest shortcomings, making Okamoto’s presence all the more important.

In a lineup still searching for its identity, and still searching for a pulse as they fade in the AL Wild Card race, there are parts of Okamoto’s offensive game that Schneider would love to see spread to the rest of the lineup.

Besides, Okamoto is running away with the team lead in home runs, his 23 more than double his next-closest teammate (George Springer, 10). It’s the same story when it comes to RBIs, too, with Okamoto’s 65 towering above his teammates (Vladimir Guerrero Jr. is second with 42).

“When he’s good, he swings with intent and hunts certain areas,” Schneider said. “He’s unique because he has power to all fields. Today to dead center is an example of that. He’s not being afraid to let it rip and let it go, and be ready for certain pitches in certain areas. He’s done a really good job of that this year.”

Still in the first year of his four-year, $60 million deal, Okamoto was one of the Blue Jays’ best moves this past offseason and has handled the move to Major League Baseball admirably. The record is all his for now, but this race isn’t over.
Munetaka Murakami of the White Sox has hit 20 in fewer games after spending some time on the IL, and he has remarkable power to match Okamoto’s if this turns into a race down the stretch.
items.titleZh: Okamoto打破Ohtani保持的日本球员新秀本垒打纪录
items.summaryZh: Okamoto以23支本垒打打破Ohtani保持的日本球员新秀本垒打纪录
bodyZh: 波士顿——周五晚在芬威球场，Kazuma Okamoto一记大力挥棒，以23支本垒打打破了大谷翔平（Shohei Ohtani）保持的日本出生球员新秀本垒打纪录。
Statcast预测的408英尺直飞中外野的本垒打，让蓝鸟在第七局终于得分，最终以4-6输给红袜。对于大联盟得分最低的进攻组来说，这是一个沉寂的赛季，Okamoto是少数亮点之一。
“他创造了日本球员单季本垒打新秀纪录，这很酷。这对他是项了不起的成就，我告诉他了，”主教练John Schneider说道。“他非常有天赋。”
任何一天你的名字和大谷翔平出现在同一句话里都是好事，尽管Okamoto对任何里程碑都轻描淡写，但他对这位日本同胞的敬意是显而易见的。两人还曾在世界棒球经典赛中一起为国效力。
“这只是一个数字，”Okamoto在明星赛前追平纪录时通过翻译Yusuke Oshima说道。“大家都知道，大谷是一位了不起的球员。他是独角兽。能够追平这个纪录显然很棒。我想尽最大努力接近他的水平。”
到了周五晚，这一点也没有改变。随着我们对Okamoto的了解——从球迷、媒体到队友——可以立刻看出他是团队至上的球员。只要有机会，他就会把话题引回队友和球队的成功上。任何能转移对自己和自己成就关注的事情，无论它们多么令人印象深刻。
“个人方面我没什么特别在意的，”Okamoto说道。“只在乎赢球。这是我看重的唯一类别。”
Okamoto的本垒打也不廉价。这个新的日本新秀纪录中没有擦墙而过的本垒打，也没有击球运气，尽管Okamoto有时确实被三振困扰，但他的力量是无可否认的。蓝鸟的进攻一直在到处寻找答案，但力量是这支球队最大的短板之一，这使得Okamoto的存在更加重要。
在一套仍在寻找身份、随着在美联外卡竞争中逐渐掉队而仍在寻找活力的打线中，Schneider希望Okamoto进攻端的某些部分能延伸到整条打线。
此外，Okamoto在本垒打上遥遥领先全队，他的23支是第二名队友（George Springer，10支）的两倍多。打点方面也是如此，Okamoto的65分打点远远超过队友（Vladimir Guerrero Jr.以42分排名第二）。
“当他状态好时，他会带着意图挥棒，并瞄准特定区域，”Schneider说道。“他独一无二，因为他对所有方向都有力量。今天打向中外野深处就是一个例子。他不害怕全力挥棒并放手一搏，并准备好应对特定区域的特定球种。今年他在这方面做得非常好。”
仍处于4年6000万美元合同第一年的Okamoto，是蓝鸟上个休赛季的最佳操作之一，并且出色地适应了大联盟。纪录现在完全属于他，但这场竞争尚未结束。
白袜的Munetaka Murakami在伤病名单上待了一段时间后，在更少的比赛中打出了20支，如果他俩在赛季末段展开竞争，他拥有与Okamoto匹敌的非凡力量。

items.titleEn: Barger set for season-ending elbow surgery to cap injury-filled campaign
bodyEn: BOSTON -- Blue Jays outfielder Addison Barger's long, frustrating season is now a lost season. Barger will undergo right elbow surgery on Monday, which could require a full Tommy John procedure.

If that’s the case, Barger’s rehab process is estimated around nine months, which would stretch well into the 2027 season. If he only needs an internal brace procedure in that elbow, it could be closer to six months.

Barger has been dealing with elbow issues for “a couple of years," manager John Schneider said Friday, but he aggravated this in May, when he uncorked a 101.2-mph throw from right field to get the tagging runner at home and end the inning. It was the hardest-tracked throw on an outfield assist in Barger’s career and the hardest of any Blue Jays player in the Statcast era (since 2015). Unfortunately, that’s come back to bite him.

Barger’s season is now officially over, his 2026 stat line reading just 1-for-22 (.045) over nine games played. First, it was a left ankle injury, then his right elbow and later his back, which developed a stress fracture. This has felt like a cursed season for the 26-year-old, who was coming off a fantastic performance in the 2025 World Series and expected to be a major contributor in ‘26.

“It’s tough to lose the whole year of at-bats, reps and performance,” Schneider said. “We were counting on him to be a big part of our team. You can see how much we miss him, for sure. It’s also a dude starting his career and trending in the right direction who’s missing, basically, a full season. It’s frustrating for him and for us.”

Ninety-nine percent of the time, when you hear “Tommy John” and “internal brace," we’re talking about a pitcher. Barger’s surgery and rehab will be unique, but if this required the full-blown procedure, there are some recent examples to work with.

Bryce Harper underwent Tommy John surgery in November 2022, and he returned to the Phillies’ lineup just 160 days later on May 2, 2023. That was as a DH, though, and Harper didn’t play the field again as a first baseman until July 21 of that season. Those are both a long way from playing right field and throwing the way Barger likes to throw, which is max effort at all times.

If Barger’s bat was undeniable and simply needed to be in the Blue Jays’ lineup, this could be an option in early 2027, but that still feels very unlikely and something only reserved for the elite tier of hitters.

Corey Seager might be a more useful case here. At the end of April 2018, Seager hit the IL and underwent Tommy John surgery soon after. He returned for Opening Day 2019, which was essentially an 11-month rehab process. Seager returned as a shortstop, too, so this works as an example of a player returning to full, regular game reps which included throwing.

The first step for Barger will come when Dr. Keith Meister performs the procedure on Monday, and a decision is made between Tommy John or the internal brace procedure. From there, it will be several months until we can get a fee for Barger’s timeline, regardless of which path this goes down.

This finally brings some clarity to Barger’s season, but that’s no consolation. In a season defined by injuries and a lack of production from core players, Barger’s frustrating 2026 campaign has unfortunately come to represent just that.
items.titleZh: Barger将接受赛季末肘部手术，结束伤病缠身的赛季
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟外野手Bagger因右肘手术赛季报销，可能需Tommy John手术，恢复期约9个月。
bodyZh: 波士顿——蓝鸟队外野手Addison Barger漫长而令人沮丧的赛季如今彻底报销。Barger将于周一接受右肘手术，可能需要完整的Tommy John手术。
如果是这样，Barger的康复过程预计约9个月，将延续到2027赛季。如果他的肘部只需要内部支撑手术，则可能接近6个月。
主教练John Schneider周五表示，Barger的肘部问题已经持续“几年”，但他在5月加重了伤势——当时他从右外野送出一记101.2英里/小时的传球，触杀本垒跑垒员结束半局。这是Barger职业生涯中外野助攻略最强的一记传球，也是Statcast时代（自2015年）以来蓝鸟球员中最强的。不幸的是，这反而对他造成了伤害。
Barger的赛季现已正式结束，他2026年的统计数据仅为9场比赛22打数1安打（打击率.045）。先是左脚踝受伤，然后是右肘，再后来是背部应力性骨折。对于这位26岁的球员来说，这感觉像是一个被诅咒的赛季——他刚在2025年世界大赛中表现出色，本被期望在2026年成为主要贡献者。
“失去一整年的打席、出场次数和表现是很难受的，”Schneider说，“我们曾指望他成为球队的重要部分。你可以看到我们有多么想念他。而且这是一个职业生涯刚刚起步、正朝正确方向前进的球员，却缺席了几乎整个赛季。这让他和我们都很沮丧。”
99%的情况下，当你听到“Tommy John”和“内部支撑”时，我们谈论的是投手。Barger的手术和康复将是独特的，但如果需要完整的手术，可以参考一些近期的例子。
Bryce Harper在2022年11月接受了Tommy John手术，仅160天后，他于2023年5月2日重返费城人队阵容。不过那是作为指定打击，Harper直到同年7月21日才再次担任一垒手守备。而守右外野并以Barger喜欢的方式（始终全力）传球，与这些都有很大距离。
如果Barger的打击实力无可争议，并且蓝鸟队阵容中确实需要他，那么2027年初复出可能是一个选择，但这仍然感觉非常不可能，而且只适用于顶尖打者。
Corey Seager可能是一个更有用的案例。2018年4月底，Seager进入伤病名单，不久后接受了Tommy John手术。他在2019年开幕日回归，这基本上是11个月的康复过程。Seager回归后仍担任游击手，因此这可以作为球员回归完整常规比赛（包括传球）的例子。
Barger的第一步将在周一由Dr. Keith Meister实施手术时进行，并在Tommy John手术或内部支撑手术之间做出决定。之后，无论选择哪条路，都需要几个月才能了解Barger的时间表。
这终于为Barger的赛季带来了一些明确性，但这并非安慰。在一个以伤病和核心球员产出不足为特点的赛季中，Barger令人沮丧的2026赛季不幸地恰恰代表了这一点。

items.titleEn: 5 numbers that tell the story of the Blue Jays' season thus far
bodyEn: This story was excerpted from Keegan Matheson’s Blue Jays Beat newsletter. To read the full newsletter, click here. And subscribe to get it regularly in your inbox.
TORONTO -- This has been a stunning, frustrating season for the Blue Jays, and all of the numbers tend to back up the eye test.
These are the numbers which capture what’s gone wrong.
1. 219 players
This is how many had more home runs than Vladimir Guerrero Jr. this season, entering play on Wednesday. If you can name all 219, you get to take an at-bat for the Blue Jays game in September.

This season has been stunning in every way. Last October, we watched as Guerrero unlocked the highest levels of his talent, batting .397 with eight home runs and a 1.289 OPS over 18 games. All of this just months after signing his 14-year, $500 million extension. How have we possibly ended up here?

Guerrero has homered just six times in 2026, and still hasn’t hit one out at Rogers Centre. Bad weeks or even bad months are going to happen -- and we’ve seen them from Guerrero before -- but nothing like this. It’s feeling like a lost year for Guerrero, and while he’s a sure bet to come back as the most motivated player on the planet next spring, that doesn’t matter right now.

It feels like the Blue Jays are drifting out of the race at this point, but for long stretches of the season when they hovered just a couple of games out of the final Wild Card spot, it was easy to play that game of “what if?” with Guerrero. If his OPS were .875 instead of hovering below .700, would they be in a playoff spot? If he’d hit 18 home runs by now instead of just six, how many games would that have flipped?
2. 20 times

If you score one or zero runs, good luck to you. The Blue Jays have done this 20 times already, nearly one-fifth of their games. It’s already happened six times in July, too, a pair of three-game stretches where this offense has fallen completely silent.

You can win without a powerhouse offense as long as “average” production stays that way from game to game, backed by elite pitching and defense. The Rays rank 14th in runs scored, but haven’t had as many power outages and play airtight baseball around this. The Blue Jays, too often, have asked their pitchers to be perfect.

The Blue Jays’ average exit velocity, as a team, ranks 29th in baseball ahead of only the Rockies. They rank right near the bottom (28th) in their percentage of hard-hit balls, too, which counts any ball hit over 95 mph.
Again, this only works if your offense is doing great work on the bases, your pitchers rank near the top of the league and your defense is elite. The Blue Jays haven’t had that balance.

This is the one point manager John Schneider keeps coming back to, which has become an issue of mental approach more than swing mechanics. Schneider wants his players to “let it rip” and is fond of saying “I’d rather you be 0-and-1 than 0-for-1.” Instead, the manager is seeing too many hitters trying to make contact and get on base.
4. Negative 1
When you rank team defenses based on Fielding Run Value, the Blue Jays sit in sixth place at +20. This means their defense has been worth 20 runs above average. That’s a bit misleading, though.

The Blue Jays’ catchers, by themselves, are worth a value of +21 here. Brandon Valenzuela instantly became one of the best defensive catchers in baseball when he was promoted earlier this season and Alejandro Kirk ranks right up there, especially when it comes to framing and blocking. Even Tyler Heineman provided defensive value while he was still with the club. The catchers, as a group, are carrying this entire value.

Narrow this to just the Blue Jays’ infielders and outfielders? That group has been worth -1 run, good for 14th in the league. This might be the most surprising part of the Blue Jays’ struggles, particularly with defensive staples like Daulton Varsho and Ernie Clement.
5. 258 strikeouts

Can Dylan Cease reach the number he’s on pace for? There’s some math and assumptions at play here, of course. Cease has averaged 8.6 strikeouts per start, so if he makes 12 more starts, that tracks out to 258.

We may never see a pitcher match Roger Clemens, who struck out 292 and 271 in his two seasons here (1997-98). Robbie Ray’s Cy Young season (‘21) ranks third with 248 strikeouts, though, and Cease has a shot.
items.titleZh: 5个数字讲述蓝鸟本赛季的故事
bodyZh: 本文摘录自Keegan Matheson的蓝鸟队报。要阅读完整版队报，请点击此处。并订阅以便定期接收。
多伦多——对于蓝鸟来说，这是一个令人震惊且沮丧的赛季，而所有数字都印证了肉眼所见。
以下是揭示问题所在的数字。
截至周三比赛前，这是本赛季本垒打数超过Vladimir Guerrero Jr.的球员数量。如果你能说出所有219人的名字，你就有资格在九月的蓝鸟比赛中获得一次打席。
这个赛季在各方面都令人震惊。去年十月，我们看到Guerrero发挥出他最高水平的天赋，在18场比赛中打击率.397，8支本垒打，OPS 1.289。而这一切仅在他签下14年5亿美元续约合同几个月后。我们怎么会走到这一步？
Guerrero在2026年仅击出6支本垒打，且尚未在罗杰斯中心开轰。糟糕的一周甚至一个月都可能发生——我们之前也见过Guerrero这样——但从未如此严重。这感觉像是Guerrero失去的一年，虽然他明年春天肯定会以全世界最有动力的球员身份回归，但目前这并不重要。
感觉蓝鸟此时正在逐渐退出竞争行列，但在本赛季很长一段时间里，当他们仅落后最终外卡席位几场比赛时，很容易对Guerrero玩起“如果当初”的游戏。如果他的OPS是.875而不是低于.700，他们是否会在季后赛位置？如果他现在已经击出18支本垒打而不是只有6支，那会改变多少场比赛？
如果你只得一分或零分，祝你好运。蓝鸟已经出现了20次这种情况，接近他们比赛的五分之一。七月份也已经发生了六次，包括两次三连战，进攻完全哑火。
没有强力进攻也能赢球，只要“平均”产出能保持稳定，并有精英级别的投球和防守作为支撑。光芒在得分榜上排名第14，但他们没有那么多断电时刻，并且围绕着这一点打出了严密的棒球。而蓝鸟则时常要求他们的投手做到完美。
蓝鸟全队的平均出口速度排名大联盟第29，仅领先于洛矶。他们在强击球百分比（击球速度超过95英里/小时）上也接近垫底（第28）。
同样，这只有在你的进攻在垒上表现出色、投手排名联盟前列、防守精英时才能奏效。蓝鸟并没有这种平衡。
这是总教练John Schneider反复强调的一点，这已成为一个心理层面而非挥杆机制的问题。Schneider希望他的球员“尽情挥击”，并喜欢说“我宁愿你是0坏1好，而不是0支1”。相反，他看到了太多打者试图碰触球上垒。
根据防守跑分价值（Fielding Run Value）排名球队防守时，蓝鸟以+20排名第六。这意味着他们的防守比平均高出20分。不过，这有点误导性。
蓝鸟的捕手单独就贡献了+21的价值。Brandon Valenzuela本赛季升上大联盟后立即成为棒球界最好的防守捕手之一，Alejandro Kirk也名列前茅，尤其是在接捕（framing）和阻挡（blocking）方面。甚至Tyler Heineman在队时也提供了防守价值。捕手群体扛起了整个价值。
仅限于蓝鸟的内野手和外野手？那群人贡献了-1分，在联盟中排名第14。这可能是蓝鸟挣扎中最令人惊讶的部分，尤其是像Daulton Varsho和Ernie Clement这样的防守核心。
Dylan Cease能否达到他目前节奏下的数字？当然这里涉及一些数学和假设。Cease平均每场先发8.6次三振，如果他再先发12场，总计将达到258次。
我们可能永远不会再看到投手达到Roger Clemens的水平，他在此效力的两个赛季（1997-98）分别三振了292和271次。Robbie Ray的赛扬奖赛季（2021年）以248次三振排名第三，而Cease有机会超越。

items.titleEn: Here are the biggest movers on each club's refreshed Top 30 list
bodyEn: The Trade Deadline arrives at 6 p.m. ET on Aug. 3 this year, and before all the commotion that comes with a flurry of moves across the Major and Minor Leagues, we figured it was time to update the MLB Pipeline team Top 30 prospects lists.

Truth be told, we’re always keeping the Top 30s in some sort of upkeep, whether it be to add new names as replacements for prospect graduates, to reflect our occasional Top 100 market corrections or to coincide with trades that have already gone down. But they still needed some new fresh coats of paint over our preseason editions.

Think of this as similar to those aforementioned market corrections. We’re not deconstructing the Top 30s completely. Instead, we’re reranking the top 10s and then adjusting worthy players up or down 10 spots beyond that. We’re also adding prospects to the top 20s who deserve such rankings but haven’t joined a list yet. With the Draft signing deadline coming up next Monday, we’ll fold in 2026 picks when we do our full in-season rerank in August.

The belief here is that when trades go down in the coming days -- and they will go down -- fans will have a better and updated understanding of the quality of prospects changing organizations during one of the busiest times of the baseball calendar.
Below is a recap of the biggest Top 30 changes and most notable movers from each farm system, along with links to the updated lists:
Jump to: AL East | AL Central | AL West | NL East | NL Central | NL West
AMERICAN LEAGUE EAST

Blue JaysThe big four of JoJo Parker, Arjun Nimmala, Nolan Perry and Johnny King remain untouched, but some of the most notable jumpers are corner infielders with MLB time in Sean Keys (up to No. 5) and Charles McAdoo (No. 12). Danny Thompson Jr., who signed for only $5,000 as an eighth-rounder last year, and Daniel Guerra leap into the top 16 for the first time, while fellow arms Ricky Tiedemann and Jake Bloss slide back to Nos. 10 and 11 as their injuries and missed time continue to pile up. Top 30 list »

OriolesNo pitcher being added to a list during this process is debuting higher on a Top 30 than Caden Hunter, coming in at No. 11, as the 2025 draftee has utilized an uptick in velocity and overall stuff to dominate two levels of A ball. He’s joined by two other newcomers: Jaiden Lo Re and DJ Layton, who were both overslot high school hitter signs from the past two Drafts (2024 and 2025). Top 30 list »

RaysTampa Bay always seems good to get a breakout out of a young talent, and this season has two in shortstop Cooper Flemming (up to No. 4) and first baseman Taitn Gray (No. 7), their second- and third-round picks from the 2026 Draft respectively. Austin Overn (No. 9) has also made a strong impression with his speed and defense after being acquired in the offseason Shane Baz deal, and after he's found some offensive success despite an oblique issue this summer, the Rays believe he might be a slight swing adjustment away from uncorking major potential. Top 30 list »

Red SoxThe Red Sox have graduated Payton Tolle, Connelly Early and Jake Bennett to Boston since the start of the season while Juan Valera had Tommy John surgery, shaking up the pitching prospects who had been atop our rankings. Shortstop Franklin Arias, right-hander Anthony Eyanson and catcher Franklin Primera have countered by significantly boosting their stock. Top 30 list »

YankeesThe Yankees opened the year with four Top 100 prospects, and shortstops George Lombard Jr. and Dax Kilby and right-handers Elmer Rodriguez and Carlos Lagrange have retained that status. New York seems to create an endless supply of pitching prospects, and left-handers Henry Lalane and Allen Facundo and righty Jack Cebert all have shown significant improvement. Top 30 list »
AMERICAN LEAGUE CENTRAL

GuardiansIt has been a good year for the Guardians' system with Travis Bazzana, Chase DeLauter and Parker Messick all making impacts in Cleveland and Top 100 prospects Angel Genao, Ralphy Velazquez and Cooper Ingle holding serve. Right-hander Justin Campbell, a 2022 supplemental first-rounder, is finally making his pro debut after years of elbow issues and quickly has risen to Triple-A. Top 30 list »

RoyalsAngeibel Gomez signed for $2.9 million in January, and the 17-year-old outfielder is already up to No. 4 in the K.C. system with his five-tool potential backed up by strong Dominican Summer League performance in 2026. Fellow 2026 signee Jaider Suárez (No. 16) also jumps into the top 20 for the first time with his above-average power and speed potential. On the pitching side, 2025 71st overall pick Justin Lamkin (No. 7) was showing major helium from the spring onward until a shoulder injury put him on the Double-A IL in late May. Top 30 list »

TigersThe trio of Max Clark, Bryce Rainer and Josue Briceño still get plenty of the oxygen up top, but pay attention to upper-level bats Eduardo Valencia (who had a hot introduction to the Majors) and Brett Callahan who slid up to Nos. 11 and 14 respectively. Third-rounder Ben Jacobs becomes the organization’s top pitching prospect, having struck out 89 in 61 1/3 innings between Single-A and High-A in his first full season. Top 30 list »

TwinsDuring Spring Training, Khadim Diaw was picked as the Twins’ breakout prospect candidate. The 2024 third-rounder had been productive in his first full year, but injuries limited him to just 42 games. Now healthy, he’s doing what the Twins thought he might, hitting his way from High-A Cedar Rapids (.895 OPS) to Double-A Wichita with a combined 120 wRC+, a big reason why he’s jumped to just outside of the top 10. Yasser Mercedes and Ben Ross join Diaw in making 10-spot jumps forward. Top 30 list »

White SoxPromoting Braden Montgomery, Noah Schultz and Sam Antonacci to Chicago has helped fuel a surprising run toward a possible AL Central title. Other than graduations, it's been fairly status quo for the White Sox system -- though it will get a huge influx of talent from No. 1 overall pick Roch Cholowsky and the rest of the club's 2026 Draft. Top 30 list »
AMERICAN LEAGUE WEST

AngelsThe big move here is by Hayden Alvarez, who ascends to the No. 2 spot on the list. Just 19 years old, he’s been doing some impressive things with Single-A Rancho Cucamonga. He hits the ball very hard and draws a lot of walks en route to an OPS of .877 and a 122 wRC+ to go along with 40+ steals. This jump from No. 10 puts him on the Top 100 watch list for sure. Top 30 list »

AstrosNo prospect is cracking these updates with a higher organizational Top 30 ranking than catcher Jason Schiavone, who checks in at No. 3 while batting .266/.416/.556 with 23 homers and 21 steals in 80 games between High-A and Double-A. The two players ahead of him, outfielder Kevin Alvarez and third baseman Xavier Neyens, have joined the overall Top 100 since the season began. Top 30 list »

A’sThree A’s prospects made 10-spot jumps, headlined by young outfielder Breyson Guedez, who has catapulted into the top 10 after skipping over the Arizona Complex League and hitting .305/.352/.443 with Single-A Stockton at age 18. Davis Diaz, who has hit his way to Double-A, and Yunior Tur, who just recently made his big league debut, join Guedez with some upward mobility. Top 30 list »

MarinersThe Mariners welcome two newcomers to their top 20. Colton Shaw may have been a money-saving senior sign out of Yale in the seventh round of the 2025 Draft, but he really knows how to pitch, which is why he’s debuting at No. 17. He’s joined by 2026 international signee Gregory Pio, whose .885 OPS in the Dominican Summer League has been a nice early return on the M’s $3 million investment in January. Top 30 list »

RangersSeveral Rangers position prospects have taken steps forward this season, with catcher Malcolm Moore rebounding from a disastrous 2025 season and shortstop Daniel Rodriguez, outfielder Hector Osorio and third baseman Rafe Perich asserting themselves. On the other hand, several of their better pitching prospects have backslid, with right-hander Jacob Johnson a notable exception. Top 30 list »
Subscribe to the MLB Pipeline Newsletter
NATIONAL LEAGUE EAST

BravesThere was some talk about flipping Eric Hartman and Cam Caminiti at the top of the list, but we decided to stand pat for the time being. Jim Jarvis is one of those “good ballplayers” who might not jump out at you if seen once, but over time it's obvious just how much he helps a team win. He’s been productive both at Triple-A and when given a chance in Atlanta, which is why we moved him up this list. Top 30 list »

MarlinsThe Marlins have had a lot of Top 100 comings and goings this year: Owen Caissie and Joe Mack rose to Miami to help an unforeseen NL wild-card contender, left-hander Robby Snelling had Tommy John surgery, right-hander Kevin Defrank came off the list following a biceps injury and righty Karson Milbrandt pitched his way on. Shortstop Starlyn Caba and outfielder Cam Cannarella could play their way onto the Top 100 soon. Top 30 list »

MetsThe graduations of Nolan McLean, Carson Benge and A.J. Ewing have taken a bite out of the talent pipeline toward the Big Apple, and this is a list that reflects that. With multiple swing-and-miss pitches, Jonathan Santucci moves behind Jonah Tong as the new No. 2 prospect in the system, and fellow lefty Zac Thornton slides into the top 10 for the first time after finding success in his first tastes of the bigs. Top 30 list »

NationalsEli Willits, Seaver King, Ronny Cruz and Devin Fitz-Gerald have taken up a lot of the oxygen when discussing the Nationals’ system in 2026. But if you thought Washington’s pitching group was limited to rehabbers Travis Sykora and Jarlin Susana, check out Jackson Kent and Miguel Sime Jr.’s moves into the top 10. Kent looks like a lefty who could help out the Nationals’ MLB rotation by season’s end, and Sime has some of the most impressive (albeit raw) stuff in the whole system. Top 30 list »

PhilliesSure, the Phillies traded catching prospect Eduardo Tait to the Twins last Trade Deadline, but that doesn’t mean there still isn’t a young backstop to be excited about. Alirio Ferrebus is making a big jump from No. 21 into the top 10 (No. 7, to be precise), and is currently leading the Single-A Florida State League in hitting (.328), slugging (.530) and OPS (.909). The 20-year old is third on the circuit with 134 wRC+. Top 30 list »
NATIONAL LEAGUE CENTRAL

BrewersMilwaukee continues to flash some of the best prospect depth in all of baseball. Yes, you know Jesús Made, Luis Peña and Luis Lara up top, but breakouts from outfielders Alexander Frias (No. 12) and Josiah Ragsdale (No. 14) help keep the wheel of talent turning so nicely for the Crew. Among pitchers, Josh Knoth (No. 11) is garnering attention in his return from Tommy John surgery and sits alongside Tyson Hardin and Bishop Letson as one of the best arms in the system. Top 30 list »

CardinalsYou can never have too much pitching, and that’s something St. Louis knows all too well with eight of its top 11 prospects making their living on top of the mound. Now ranked No. 11, Jacob Odle was sitting outside the Top 30 at the beginning of the season but has shown the most growth with three above-average pitches in his fastball, curveball and slider. Among bats, 18-year-old middle infielder Sebastian Dos Santos waited in vain for a Top 30 slot to open and now finds himself making his list debut at No. 12 thanks to above-average power potential on the dirt. Top 30 list »

CubsWhile the top of our Cubs Top 30 looks a lot different than it did four months ago -- Moisés Ballesteros and Kevin Alcántara have graduated, right-hander Jaxon Wiggins and outfielder Ethan Conrad have missed significant time with injuries -- it has been a positive summer for the system. Pedro Ramirez made the Top 100 before rushing to Chicago, outfielder Josiah Hartshorn and catcher Owen Ayers are surpassing expectations and Brooks Caple and Mason McGwire have added some much-needed pitching depth. Top 30 list »

PiratesIf the Pirates are looking for an area of depth to trade from to bolster a playoff run, they might want to look behind the plate. They have three catchers in their top 10, starting with Axiel Plaz (.308/.385/.488, age 20, High-A Greensboro) skyrocketing to No. 6, 2025 draftee Easton Carmichael (.311/.355/.528, age 21, High-A) elevated to No. 7 and 20-year-old Edgleen Perez, who came over in last year’s David Bednar trade, hitting .288 with a .377 OBP and providing outstanding defense for Single-A Bradenton, now at No. 8. Top 30 list »

RedsA couple of teenagers are on the move here, starting with catcher Jirvin Morillo. After spending two summers in the Dominican Summer League, Morillo is excelling in his stateside debut, leading the Arizona Complex League with 13 homers while sitting second in slugging (.652) and third in OPS (1.101) to vault him to No. 8 on this list. Angel Nuñez, the Reds’ top acquisition on the international market in January, isn’t far behind him at No. 11, thanks to a strong DSL debut (.938 OPS). Top 30 list »
NATIONAL LEAGUE WEST

D-backsThere’s a new king atop the Arizona hill in second baseman Demetrio Crisantes. A lifetime .321 hitter in the Minor Leagues, the only thing stopping the right-handed slugger’s ascent in recent years has been injuries, and after overcoming an early hamstring strain this season, he’s already pushed his way to Triple-A at 21 years old. The biggest jumper is catcher Alberto Barriga (No. 14), who has a lightning arm behind the plate and is showing better power in his age-21 season on his way to Double-A. Top 30 list »

DodgersIt's business as usual for the Dodgers, who are challenging for MLB's best record while pursuing their third consecutive World Series championship and boasting a baseball-best nine Top 100 prospects. Almost all of their best farmhands are having strong seasons, with right-hander Brady Smith making the biggest jump in the system now that he's healthy. Top 30 list »

GiantsNo system is on the rise more than this one. Shortstops Josuar Gonzalez and Luis Hernández look like future superstars at ages 18 and 17 respectively, and there's quality and depth of talent behind them. Outfielder Jonah Cox and catcher Drew Cavanaugh have been pleasant development surprises who have reached San Francisco this season. Top 30 list »

PadresEthan Salas’ return to health and form at Double-A San Antonio has been the easy story of the San Diego system in 2026, and his place at the top of the list was secure heading into this process. Lefties Kash Mayfield and Kruz Schoolcraft are still in the conversation for top arm in the system, and don’t overlook righty Bryan Balzer, who climbs up to No. 7 in this update with a fastball in the upper 90s, a plus slider and a good splitter. There’s still enough talent here to make the Trade Deadline interesting should the Padres opt to buy again on or before Aug. 3. Top 30 list »

RockiesWhile Andy Perez rejoined the list in the teens with a fine season at Double-A, the bigger news might be the pair of prospects who have jumped into the top 10. Cristian Arguelles, hit .422 in his second summer of play in the DSL in 2025 en route to winning the league’s MVP and batting title. He might be in line to repeat the feat during his U.S. debut in the Arizona Complex League, which he currently tops in average (.402) and OPS (1.149). That's why he’s all the way up at No. 6 now. He’s joined by right-hander Jackson Cox, who clearly has put 2024 Tommy John surgery behind him and currently leads all Minor Leaguers in strikeouts (122). Top 30 list »

items.summaryZh: 交易截止日前更新各队潜力新秀排名，蓝鸟等队有显著变动。
bodyZh: 今年交易截止日为美国东部时间8月3日下午6点，在大小联盟一系列交易引发轰动之前，我们决定更新MLB Pipeline各队Top 30新秀名单。
说实话，我们一直在维护Top 30名单，无论是添加新秀替代毕业球员，反映偶尔的Top 100市场修正，还是配合已完成的交易。但相比季前版本，它们仍需一些新面貌。
可以将此视为类似上述市场修正。我们并非完全重建Top 30，而是重新排列前十名，然后调整其他球员的排名（上升或下降10个位置）。我们还将那些值得上榜但尚未进入名单的新秀添加到前20名中。由于下周一为选秀签约截止日，我们将在8月进行完整的赛季中重新排名时纳入2026年选秀球员。
我们相信，在未来几天交易发生时——而且肯定会发生——球迷们将对棒球日历最繁忙时期之一中更换球队的新秀质量有更好、更新的了解。

游骑兵：几名游骑兵位置新秀本赛季取得进步，捕手Malcolm Moore从灾难性的2025赛季反弹，游击手Daniel Rodriguez、外野手Hector Osorio和三垒手Rafe Perich也崭露头角。另一方面，他们几名较好的投手新秀有所退步，右投手Jacob Johnson是例外。Top 30名单»

国家联盟西区
响尾蛇：亚利桑那迎来了新的山顶之王——二垒手Demetrio Crisantes。他在小联盟生涯打击率为.321，近年来唯一阻碍这位右打重炮手上升的是伤病，本赛季克服早期腿筋拉伤后，他已在21岁年龄升至3A。最大跃升者是捕手Alberto Barriga（第14），他拥有闪电般的手臂，并在21岁赛季展现更强力量，正迈向2A。Top 30名单»

巨人：没有哪个体系比这个上升得更快。游击手Josuar Gonzalez（18岁）和Luis Hernández（17岁）看起来是未来的超级巨星，他们身后还有天赋的质量和深度。外野手Jonah Cox和捕手Drew Cavanaugh是令人惊喜的发展成果，本赛季已升上旧金山。Top 30名单»

教士：Ethan Salas在2A圣安东尼奥恢复健康和状态是2026年圣迭戈体系中最简单的故事，他在名单顶端的位置在本次更新前就已稳固。左投手Kash Mayfield和Kruz Schoolcraft仍在竞争体系最佳手臂，别忘了右投手Bryan Balzer，他在这次更新中升至第7位，拥有95英里以上的快速球、平均以上的滑球和不错的指叉球。如果教士选择在8月3日或之前再次采购，这里仍有足够的天赋使交易截止日变得有趣。Top 30名单»

洛矶：Andy Perez凭借在2A的出色赛季重新进入名单的十几位，但更大的新闻可能是一对跃入前10的新秀。Cristian Arguelles在2025年DSL第二季击出.422，赢得联盟MVP和打击王。他在美国首秀（亚利桑那复合联盟）中可能再次实现这一壮举，目前以.402打击率和1.149的OPS领跑。这就是他升至第6的原因。与他一起的还有右投手Jackson Cox，他显然已将2024年的Tommy John手术抛在身后，目前领跑所有小联盟球员的三振数（122次）。Top 30名单»

items.titleEn: Bieber finding vintage form again with season-best 7-inning gem
bodyEn: TORONTO -- Despite getting off to a slow start when he initially returned from the injured list in June, Shane Bieber looks to have found his groove for the Blue Jays.
That continued on Thursday, as Bieber silenced the American League-leading Rays bats over seven innings of one-run ball at Rogers Centre while surrendering just three hits in Toronto’s 3-1 victory.
The win snapped the Blue Jays’ four-game losing streak and ensured Toronto wasn’t swept by its division rival at home.

Bieber needed just 86 pitches (57 strikes) to get through his season-high in innings pitched, striking out three during an outing where he relied heavily upon his fastball. The 31-year-old threw his heater 33 times -- averaging 92.5 mph with the offering -- while mixing in a variety of changeups, cutters, knuckle curves, sinkers and sliders.

The only run Tampa Bay managed came after a two-out rally in the third inning, when Hunter Feduccia doubled off the right-field wall before Yandy Díaz brought him home with a single on a 1-0 breaking ball.

After allowing 12 combined runs through his first three starts off the injured list, Bieber has now rattled off three consecutive positive outings as he continues to take steps in the right direction now that he’s settled back into the Major Leagues.

Bieber seemingly began his turnaround in a July 10 start against the Padres, where he settled in after two first-inning runs before shutting down San Diego for the next 3 2/3 frames. He then came out of the break with six scoreless frames against the White Sox on Saturday, striking out a season-best six batters.

“I think that he's kind of been trending up from his outing in San Diego to his last one,” Blue Jays manager John Schneider said of Bieber pregame. “I think that he's kind of kicked the rust off a little bit from the layoff, and he's in a better spot delivery-wise.”

Toronto delivered enough offense to back its starter on Thursday, thanks to some heads-up baserunning from Ernie Clement in the first inning and RBI singles from George Springer and Vladimir Guerrero Jr. in the third and seventh innings.

Clement opened the scoring when he raced around from second after an Alejandro Kirk infield hit got away from Rays third baseman Junior Caminero, allowing the Blue Jays to steal a run right out of the gate.
items.titleZh: 比伯重现巅峰，赛季最佳7局精彩表现
items.summaryZh: 比伯7局失1分，助蓝鸟3-1胜光芒，终结4连败。
bodyZh: 多伦多——尽管6月从伤病名单回归后开局缓慢，但Shane Bieber似乎已为蓝鸟找到了节奏。
周四，比伯在罗杰斯中心主投7局仅失1分，只被敲出3支安打，压制了美国联盟领先的光芒打线，帮助多伦多3-1获胜。
这场胜利终结了蓝鸟的四连败，并确保多伦多未在主场被分区对手横扫。
比伯仅用86球（57好球）就完成了赛季最高的投球局数，他大量依赖速球，三振了3名打者。这位31岁投手投了33颗速球，平均球速92.5英里/小时，同时混合了各种变速球、卡特球、指叉曲球、伸卡球和滑球。
坦帕湾的唯一得分来自第三局两出局后的反攻，Hunter Feduccia击出右外野墙上的二垒安打，随后Yandy Díaz在1-0的变速球上击出一垒安打将他送回本垒。
在从伤病名单回归后的前三场先发中共失12分后，比伯现已连续三场表现出色，随着他重新适应大联盟，正在朝正确方向不断迈进。
比伯似乎从7月10日对教士的先发开始反弹，当时他在首局失2分后稳住阵脚，随后3又2/3局封锁了圣迭戈。全明星赛后，他在周六对白袜的比赛中投了6局无失分，三振了赛季最高的6名打者。
“我认为他从圣地亚哥那场到最近一场一直在上升，”蓝鸟总教练John Schneider赛前谈到比伯时说。“我认为他因休战而生疏的状态已有所恢复，投球机制也更好了。”
多伦多周四也为先发投手提供了足够的火力支持，这得益于Ernie Clement在第一局机智的跑垒，以及George Springer和Vladimir Guerrero Jr.分别在第三局和第七局击出的打点一垒安打。
Clement率先得分，他乘Alejandro Kirk的内野安打被光芒三垒手Junior Caminero漏接之机，从二垒跑回本垒，让蓝鸟一开场就偷到一分。

items.titleEn: Blue Jays announce signing of top pick Carlon, 16 others from Draft class
bodyEn: TORONTO -- The Blue Jays have agreed to a $2.4 million bonus with their first pick from the 2026 MLB Draft, lefty Cole Carlon.

The bonus, first reported by MLB Pipeline’s Jim Callis, comes in just below the slot value for the No. 39 pick, which is $2,571,700. The Blue Jays did not pick in the first round because they, along with the Dodgers, Mets, Phillies and Yankees, received a 10-pick penalty on their first pick for exceeding the second surcharge threshold of the Competitive Balance Tax, which bumped them back to No. 39.

Carlon is a powerhouse on the mound, every bit of 6-foot-5, 230 pounds with the ability to touch triple digits. Callis also calls his slider the best in the MLB Draft, and the Blue Jays were thrilled to land the Arizona State product where they did, expecting him to be off the board by the time they got their first crack at the Draft.

“One of my friends texted me after, and I was laughing about the way he put it. He said that ‘He’s got two October pitches,’” said director of amateur scouting Marc Tramuta. “I felt like that was a good characterization of the fastball and slider that are currently in place. We just like the big physicality at 6-foot-5. We think there’s some athleticism to his delivery.”

Carlon’s 133 strikeouts over just 83 2/3 innings ranked fifth in Division 1 this past NCAA season, and given the Blue Jays’ success with Trey Yesavage coming out of college, it’s easy to dream on how quickly Carlon could climb the ladder.

Given his NCAA workload this season, which was already ramping up from a bullpen role in previous seasons, don’t expect the Blue Jays to push Carlon much more in 2026. It’s possible he’s shut down entirely and spends the rest of this summer focused on development at the club’s complex in Dunedin, Fla., but once Carlon gets on a mound, he’ll be a must-watch prospect in this system.

“He throws backwards. He throws his slider more than any other pitch,” said Baseball America’s Carlos Collazo on MLB Network’s Draft coverage. “He throws that about 52% of the time. You look at how big this guy is, I see Robbie Ray, just a bigger version of him. The Blue Jays had [Ray]. This guy is going to come at you, but you’re going to be guessing. Are you going to get a 100 mph pitch or are you going to get a slider that has incredible movement?”

Money matters, of course, especially with the Blue Jays having the second-smallest bonus pool in the Draft. Coming in roughly $170,000 below the slot value on Carlon’s pick is valuable, along with some of the bonus pool money the Blue Jays are expected to save in rounds four through 10, where they went heavy on college picks. All of these arrows point to catcher Will Brick, the high schooler who represents the Blue Jays’ “big swing” of this class.

Brick was widely considered the best prep catcher in this class and had been connected to the Blue Jays as early as the No. 39 pick, but they landed him in the fourth round (No. 131) and are expected to make an aggressive, over-slot play to land him. An excellent defensive catcher, Brick’s power also has Tramuta and the Blue Jays’ scouting group excited. Presuming the Blue Jays pull this off, which would be a major win for their farm system, Brick would immediately become one of the highest-upside position players in Toronto’s Top 30.
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟宣布签约首轮新秀Carlon及其他16名选秀球员
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟以240万美元签约首轮投手Cole Carlon，并有望签下高中捕手Will Brick。
bodyZh: 多伦多 -- 蓝鸟已与2026年MLB选秀的首轮新秀、左投手Cole Carlon达成240万美元签约金的协议。
该签约金由MLB Pipeline的Jim Callis最先报道，略低于第39顺位的对应奖金（2,571,700美元）。蓝鸟未能在首轮选秀，因为他们与道奇、大都会、费城人和洋基一样，因超过竞争平衡税的第二门槛而受到首轮顺位倒退10位的处罚，从而掉到第39顺位。
Carlon是一名强大的投手，身高6英尺5英寸（约1.96米），体重230磅（约104公斤），能投出三位数的速球。Callis还称他的滑球是本MLB选秀中最好的，蓝鸟非常高兴能在该顺位选中这位亚利桑那州立大学的球员，原本预计他会在蓝鸟首次选秀前就被挑走。
“选秀后我一个朋友给我发短信，我觉得他的说法很有趣。他说‘他有两个十月级别的球路’，”蓝鸟业余球探总监Marc Tramuta说。“我认为这很好地描述了他现有的速球和滑球。我们喜欢他6英尺5英寸的大体格，我们认为他的投球动作具有运动能力。”
Carlon在2026年NCAA赛季中，仅用83 2/3局就投出133次三振，在全美一级联赛中排名第五。考虑到蓝鸟此前成功培养大学出身的Trey Yesavage，不难想象Carlon能多快晋升。
鉴于他本赛季在NCAA的投球量已经比之前几个赛季作为牛棚投手时有所增加，预计蓝鸟不会在2026年对他施加更多压力。他可能会完全休息，整个夏天在佛罗里达州达尼丁的球队基地专注于发展。但一旦Carlon站上投手丘，他将是蓝鸟系统中备受关注的潜力新秀。
“他反向配球。他投滑球的次数比其他任何球种都多，”《棒球美国》的Carlos Collazo在MLB Network的选秀报道中说。“他大约52%的时间投滑球。看看这家伙的身材，我觉得他像Robbie Ray，只是更大一号。蓝鸟曾经有过Ray。他会向你进攻，但你会猜不到：你会看到100英里的速球，还是拥有惊人位移的滑球？”
当然，金钱因素也很重要，尤其是蓝鸟的签约奖金池在选秀中位列第二小。在Carlon的顺位上省下约17万美元很有价值，此外蓝鸟预计在第4至第10轮（主要选择大学球员）也能节省部分奖金池资金。所有这些迹象都指向高中捕手Will Brick，他是蓝鸟本届选秀的‘大手笔’。
Brick被广泛认为是本届选秀中最好的高中捕手，早在第39顺位时蓝鸟就与他联系在一起，但他们最终在第4轮（第131顺位）选中他，并预计会以高于顺位价值的签约金签下他。作为一名出色的防守型捕手，Brick的力量也让Tramuta和蓝鸟球探团队感到兴奋。如果蓝鸟能成功签下他，这将是农场的重大胜利，Brick将立即成为蓝鸟top30新秀中潜力最高的位置球员之一。

items.titleEn: Amid flurry of moves, Schneider back with Blue Jays, Corbin heading to IL
bodyEn: Before Thursday's game against the Rays, the Blue Jays recalled both INF/OF Davis Schneider and LHP Adam Macko from Triple-A Buffalo, optioned INF Sean Keys to Buffalo and placed LHP Patrick Corbin on the 15-day IL with a left teres major strain, retroactive to Wednesday.

Schneider, who hit 11 homers for last year's AL champions, has hit just .153 with three home runs and 12 RBIs in 49 games with Toronto this season. He performed much better for Buffalo, hitting .253 with a .986 OPS and five homers in 30 games.
Macko is 2-0 with a 5.03 ERA in 19 games for Toronto this season. He had a 4.18 ERA in 18 appearances for Buffalo.
Corbin, in his first season with the Blue Jays, is 3-4 with a 5.51 ERA in 19 games.
Keys has hit .167 with one homer and five RBIs in 12 games with Toronto.
